title: Autonomous Rotary-Wing UAV
tagline: Real-time object detection and precision waypoint navigation
summary: A full autonomous drone pipeline: an onboard companion computer runs object detection and sends velocity and waypoint commands to an ArduPilot flight controller over MAVLink.
architecture: Camera frames go through a YOLOv8 node in ROS 2. A tracker node converts detections into setpoints, and a PyMAVLink bridge streams them to the flight controller with heartbeat monitoring.
results: Flight tests confirmed stable tracking at cruise speed with automatic return-to-launch on link loss.

title: 6-Axis Robotic Arm
tagline: Inverse kinematics and pick-and-place with a custom gripper
summary: A desktop manipulator designed in SolidWorks, validated with FEA, and controlled through MoveIt for collision-free pick-and-place.

title: Visual Defect Inspection
tagline: OpenCV and deep learning quality checks on a moving line
summary: A camera-based inspection station that flags surface defects on parts in real time and logs each result.

title: STM32 Motor Controller
tagline: Field-oriented control for a brushless drive
summary: A compact BLDC driver board with field-oriented control firmware and a CAN interface for robot joints.
